changeSet.author: openelis
changeSet.comment: A deployment whose pathologists picked stain names from a list: one case with a block and a slide, and two requests on file. One is a dictionary-style request with no last_updated, which 010 must give a version; the other is a completed text request that already has one. Neither has a kind, target, priority, author or date, and neither may come out of the upgrade with any.
